svg.text: 2D plan · ROOM-1 and ROOM-4 single (queen) · ROOM-2 and ROOM-3 twin · all dimensions in feet and inches · rear at top, road at bottom
Blue = furniture: Wakefit Orion queen / Centaur single beds, Tinker side tables, Gingham / Twill wardrobes, Sage study tables; AMATA sofa (Amazon).
Yellow = door swing; every door opens inwards. Light blue on walls = windows.
Walls, doors and windows from the architect's AFTER O.C. drawing. Furniture positions are proposals.
